documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Un-Audited Standalone Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30.06.2026
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015- Reconstitution Of CSR Committee

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a 16% revenue growth for FY 2025-26, supported by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB. The company maintained a 29% EBITDA margin and a 15% PAT margin during the year. Management highlighted significant infrastructure investments, including a new Neuro Sciences & OPD block and plans for a 300-bed pediatric hospital. The company continues to focus on clinical excellence, technological integration, and expanding its academic initiatives. Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a 12.43% increase in operating income for FY 2024-25, reaching ₹ 1,37,111.30 Lakhs.

guidance.claim: The company achieved a 12% growth in the financial year 2024-25 compared to 2023-24.
guidance.quote: The year 2024-25 was a very good year for us. We have achieved a 12% growth compared to 2023-24.

guidance.claim: The company reported a profit margin of 15% for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college has seen high demand for admissions, with all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake. Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board has approved the construction of a 300-bed pediatric hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: A defining milestone of this fiscal year was the grand inauguration of the new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block by the Hon’ble Vice President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, on January 15, 2026. Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add 100 beds to its main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to establish a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The outpatient block for the new hospital project is expected to be ready by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 5239.02 Lakhs in equipment during the 2023-24 financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 29% and a PAT margin of 15% for the fiscal year.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved a 31% reduction in annual power bills through solar and wind power usage.
margins_costs.quote: In line with this concept, your company operates a 5.25 MW solar power generation plant and purchases wind-generated power, covering nearly 68% of the annual power requirement. This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates as a 2,250-bed multi-locational, multi-disciplinary super specialty hospital.
orders_capacity.quote: Nurtured with Indian hospitality and a western mind set, KMCH has grown into a 2,250 bed multi-locational, multi- disciplinary Super specialty hospital, the best and most trusted in Southern India.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital currently operates with a capacity of 2,000 beds.
orders_capacity.quote: Congratulations. Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a total employee strength of 5,286 as of March 31, 2024.
orders_capacity.quote: The total strength of the employees of the Company as on 31st March 2024 was 5286.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹15 per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified rising costs of consumables, employee expenditure, and financing as factors that shrink margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Rising cost of consumables, employee expenditure and financing cost shrinks our margin.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted that operational costs are currently climbing faster than reimbursements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The “Cost-Reimbursement Gap”: Operational costs are currently climbing faster than reimbursements, threatening the long-term solvency of many regional and community hospitals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The healthcare industry faces a shortage of skilled medical professionals, which impacts the ability to deliver quality care.
risks_headwinds.quote: The shortage of skilled medical professionals is a pressing issue in the healthcare industry, impacting institutions like KMCH and their ability to deliver quality care effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Construction work for the 300-bed pediatric hospital is expected to commence in the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company will add 100 beds to the main campus.
management_commitments.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
management_commitments.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

management_commitments.claim: The OP block will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The company is in the process of registering lease agreements with a tenor of more than 11 months.
management_commitments.quote: All Lease Agreements with more than 11 months’ tenor, require registration with Department of Revenue, Ministry of Commercial Taxes and Registration, Government of Tamil Nadu. The Company is in the process of registering the Lease Agreements.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
